methodology.sampling: Every discovered DAT part and standalone NXLV/LVL is inventoried; configured aliases are not double-counted.
methodology.joins: Ordered piece bounding-box adjacency/overlap, not proof of solid-alpha contact.
methodology.gaps: Empty columns between occupied columns in the final ordered alpha composite; not route-solvability claims.
methodology.ledges: Adjacent topmost solid-column height changes of at least 3 pixels.
methodology.decoration: Heuristic low-fill terrain clusters, not authored semantic labels.
methodology.routes: Source-observed horizontal repeated pieces, alpha-composited and filtered for continuous support, max step5, range10, thickness3.
methodology.special: VGASPEC bitmaps are counted and parsed but excluded from tile-assembly formulas.

inventory.scope: Repository source tree, excluding symlinks and generated/cache directories
